plugins.photosPermission: Recall uses your photos to attach them to memories you log.
plugins.cameraPermission: Recall uses your camera to capture photos and videos for your memories.

plugins.photosPermission: Recall scans your photo library so it can place your photos on the days they were taken.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Recall does not need to save photos, only read them.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Recall uses your location to tag where a memory happened, and to read where imported photos were taken.

plugins.contactsPermission: Recall can use a contact's photo and name to fill in a person's profile, so you don't have to find one in your photos. It only looks when you ask it to.
